French Fried Apples
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 18, 2009 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




2 eggs -- beaten
1 tablespoon sugar
3 tablespoons flour
4 apples -- peeled, cored, and sliced
Vegetable oil
Powdered sugar

Preparation

1 In small bowl combine eggs, sugar, and flour, beating well. Dip each apple slice in batter. Deep fry in oil until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels. Dust with powdered sugar. 2 Yield: 4 servings.
